context_cost_warning.message: full profile installs all 153 packaged skills, 143 more than the 10-skill core default; every installed skill adds an index line to every Hermes request and about 8k chars each time its body loads (a loaded body stays in history until compaction), so this context weight grows with the catalog; prefer core unless this workspace genuinely needs the complete catalog.

skill_profile_state.context_cost_note: Every installed skill adds an index line to every Hermes request and about 8k chars each time its body loads, and a loaded body stays in history until compaction, so an install that still carries full-only skills costs full-profile context weight even when the recorded profile is core.
skill_profile_state.non_destructive_default: omh setup, install, and update never delete installed skills, so a full install keeps its skills after the recorded profile changes; run `omh skill-profile reconcile --to core` explicitly to shrink an existing full install.

prompt_cost.claim_boundary: These are OMH-local filesystem estimates, not observed serialized request bytes, selected skill bodies, provider input tokens, or cache counters. Use `hermes prompt-size --json` for host-observed prompt accounting.
